questions.question: PM 3. Woman has left upper quadrant pain, fever, unwell. She grows GNB in both blood and urine cultures. It is a lactose fermenter with mucoid colonies. It is indole-negative.

parts.text: What are 4 other carbapenem resistant enzymes that are clinically important (2)

cohort_answer.text: Klebsiella pneumoniae (E. coli is indole positive). Other carbapenemases: NDM-1, KPC, VIM, IMP, SME, OXA-48, GES.
